霖多多说着，想去触碰一下。可刚弯下腰，指尖还没触到床上那人的衣角，敲门声突然响起，又急又响。

霖多多转身出了卧室，把门打开，才发现是那位卷毛管家。

“霖女士，您回来啦？需要服务吗？”

霖多多摆摆手：“不需要，谢谢。”说完又要转身回卧室。

常野头皮一紧。决不能让霖多多碰到床上的上官程——那是活人，有呼吸有心跳。一旦她摸到胸口那微弱的起伏，或者感觉到皮肤下真实的温度，他家老大的身份就暴露了。

上官程和霖多多之间的主仆契约还没解除，身份暴露会引发什么后果，连他这个系统都说不准。

“我们正在搞抽奖活动！”他提高音量，声音在走廊里弹了一下，“一等奖是豪华海鲜双人大餐！”

霖多多对吃的兴趣一般，脚步没停。但彭源的眼睛瞬间亮了，像两颗被点亮的灯泡。她一把拽住霖多多，三步并作两步冲到常野面前。

“海鲜大餐？多豪华？真的假的？”

常野见这招有效，当即添油加醋：“米其林厨师亲自操刀，海胆龙虾鲍鱼不限量，你想吃的全都有。”

彭源的呼吸都粗重了：“三文鱼？金枪鱼？”

“管饱。”常野低头看了一眼手机，“不过活动马上截止了，建议你们快点。”

彭源二话不说，拽着霖多多就往外走：“快快快！你手气好，肯定能中！”

“诶——阿九还没……”霖多多扭头看了一眼卧室的方向，脚步有些迟疑。

“不就是充个电嘛？”彭源走得飞快，“他之前在家没充过？”

“充过，但都是开机状态充的。这次好像是关机了……”

“那肯定是为了充得更快呗。”彭源头也不回，“他能有什么事？赶紧的！”

霖多多想了想，也是。阿九不过是在充电，等她回来，电充满了，人也醒了，到时候再问他关于上官程的事也不迟。

常野是高级系统，快速用手机编了个抽奖小程序，让霖多多去抽，然后顺利成章的得了一等奖。

为了阻止霖多多返回房间，他还编造了一个附加奖品——送了两人两张上官集团旗下游乐场的票，当日有效。立刻派车将二人送了过去。

霖多多这一天被安排得满满当当。白天在游乐场玩得痛快，晚上又被人拉去吃了一顿大餐。

常野怕她们回去太早撞上什么，晚餐时又送了几瓶价格不菲的葡萄酒，把人灌得不省人事，才安心送了回去。

彭源被送回了自己家。

霖多多则回了那套“二百块得总统套房”。

与此同时，上官程刚把证据交到父亲手里。

他站在上官清越的办公室里，窗外的城市灯火通明。他正准备说点什么，右边屁股上突然传来一阵熟悉的揉捏感。

Lin Duoduo said, wanting to touch it.But just as he bent down, before his fingertips touched the clothes of the man on the bed, a knock on the door suddenly sounded, urgent and loud.

Lin Duoduo turned around and left the bedroom, opened the door, and found out that it was the curly-haired housekeeper.

"Ms. Lin, are you back? Do you need service?"

Lin Duoduo waved his hand: "No, thank you." After saying that, he turned around and went back to the bedroom.

Changye's scalp tightened.Lin Duoduo must not be allowed to touch Shangguan Cheng on the bed - that is a living person, breathing and heartbeating.Once she felt the faint rise and fall of his chest, or felt the real temperature under his skin, his identity as the boss was revealed.

The master-servant contract between Shangguan Cheng and Lin Duoduo has not yet been terminated. Even his system cannot predict what consequences will arise if their identities are exposed.

"We are holding a lottery!" He raised his voice and his voice bounced in the corridor. "The first prize is a luxurious seafood dinner for two people!"

Lin Duoduo was only interested in eating and kept walking.But Peng Yuan's eyes lit up instantly, like two light bulbs being lit.She grabbed Lin Duoduo and rushed to Chang Ye in three steps at a time.

"Seafood dinner? How luxurious? Is it real or fake?"

Seeing that this trick was effective, Chang Ye immediately added fuel and vinegar: "The Michelin chef personally cooks it. There is no limit to sea urchin, lobster, and abalone. You can have everything you want."

Peng Yuan's breathing became heavy: "Salmon? Tuna?"

"It's enough." Changye lowered his head and glanced at his phone, "But the event will end soon, so I suggest you hurry up."

Without saying a word, Peng Yuan dragged Lin Duoduo out and walked out: "Hurry, hurry, hurry! You are lucky, you will definitely hit!"

"Eh - Ah Jiu hasn't..." Lin Duoduo turned his head and glanced in the direction of the bedroom, hesitating in his steps.

"Isn't it just to charge the battery?" Peng Yuan walked quickly, "Has he never charged it at home before?"

"It has been charged before, but it was all done while the phone was on. This time it seems to have been turned off..."

"It must be to recharge faster." Peng Yuanyuan didn't reply, "What can happen to him? Hurry up!"

Lin Duoduo thought about it, too.Ah Jiu was just charging. When she came back, the battery was fully charged and she woke up. It would not be too late to ask him about Shangguan Cheng.

Chang Ye was an advanced system, so he quickly programmed a small lottery program on his mobile phone and asked Lin Duoduo to draw, and then successfully won the first prize.

In order to prevent Lin Duoduo from returning to the room, he also made up an additional prize-two tickets to the Shangguan Group's amusement park for the two of them, valid for that day.A car was immediately sent to take the two of them there.

Lin Duoduo had a full schedule this day.I had a great time at the amusement park during the day, and was taken to a big meal at night.

Changye was afraid that they would run into something if they went back too early, so he sent several bottles of expensive wine to them during dinner, and drank them unconscious before sending them back with peace of mind.

Peng Yuan was sent back to his home.

Lin Duoduo returned to the "presidential suite for 200 yuan".

At the same time, Shangguan Cheng Gang handed the evidence into his father's hands.

He stood in Shangguan Qingyue's office, and the city lights outside the window were brightly lit.He was about to say something when a familiar kneading feeling suddenly came from his right buttocks.
